# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

pharmacist access and more.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

[[flag][flag]

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## Be Part of Something Powerful this Month

Don’t miss your chance to make a generous gift to our 2026 Summer Annual Fund Drive to help fund
essential care and support as well as advance critical Alzheimer’s research.

[ Donate Now ][55]
[Walk to End Alzheimer's logo]


# Get Moving with Walk to End Alzheimer's

There's growing evidence that healthy habits like walking can help protect your brain for years to
come. Now is the perfect time to rally your coworkers, friends and family to start a Walk to End
Alzheimer's® team.

[ Register for Your Walk ][56]
[Family]

### Together, We Can
### End Alzheimer's

The Alzheimer's Association leads the way to end Alzheimer's and all other dementia — by
accelerating global research, driving risk reduction and early detection, and maximizing quality
care and support.

**But we can't end Alzheimer's without your help.**

[Donate Now][57]

## [Everyday Actions. Lifelong Impact.][58]

Sign up for the (re)think your brain™ 6-Step Challenge for a guide to better brain health. Learn
healthy habits that can help you live better now and potentially lower your risk of dementia.
[Start the Challenge][59]

## [Get the Latest Dementia Research Updates][60]

Join us for AAIC For All: Community, a no-cost virtual event for members of the public to learn
about the latest findings in dementia research, straight from the experts themselves. Watch the
presentations live on July 16 or view the recordings afterward.
[Register for Free][61]

## [Turn Your Summer Fun into a Fundraiser][62]

Hosting a cookout, pickleball tournament or outdoor movie night? Make your event more meaningful by
adding a simple way to give back. Support Do What You Love to End ALZ™ by adding a suggested
donation or silent auction to an event you already have planned. 
[Get Started][63]

Understanding Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia

Alzheimer's is the most common form of dementia. It causes problems with memory, thinking and
behavior.

Talk to a dementia expert with our free 24/7 Helpline. Get confidential support, crisis assistance,
local resources and information in over 200 languages.

## Be Part of Something Powerful this Month

## Be Part of Something Powerful this Month

Don’t miss your chance to make a generous gift to our 2026 Summer Annual Fund Drive to help fund
essential care and support as well as advance critical Alzheimer’s research.

[ Donate Now ][55]
[Walk to End Alzheimer's logo]


# Get Moving with Walk to End Alzheimer's

There's growing evidence that healthy habits like walking can help protect your brain for years to
come. Now is the perfect time to rally your coworkers, friends and family to start a Walk to End
Alzheimer's® team.

[ Register for Your Walk ][56]
[Family]

### Together, We Can
### End Alzheimer's

The Alzheimer's Association leads the way to end Alzheimer's and all other dementia — by
accelerating global research, driving risk reduction and early detection, and maximizing quality
care and support.

**But we can't end Alzheimer's without your help.**

[Donate Now][57]

## [Everyday Actions. Lifelong Impact.][58]

Sign up for the (re)think your brain™ 6-Step Challenge for a guide to better brain health. Learn
healthy habits that can help you live better now and potentially lower your risk of dementia.
[Start the Challenge][59]

## [Get the Latest Dementia Research Updates][60]

Join us for AAIC For All: Community, a no-cost virtual event for members of the public to learn
about the latest findings in dementia research, straight from the experts themselves. Watch the
presentations live on July 16 or view the recordings afterward.
[Register for Free][61]

## [Turn Your Summer Fun into a Fundraiser][62]

Hosting a cookout, pickleball tournament or outdoor movie night? Make your event more meaningful by
adding a simple way to give back. Support Do What You Love to End ALZ™ by adding a suggested
donation or silent auction to an event you already have planned. 
[Get Started][63]

Understanding Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia

Alzheimer's is the most common form of dementia. It causes problems with memory, thinking and
behavior.
* [About Alzheimer's and Dementia][64]
* [Know the 10 Warning Signs][65]
* [Navigating Diagnosis][66]
* [Understanding the Stages][67]
* [Support for Caregivers][68]
* [Living With a Diagnosis][69]
* [Recursos en español][70]

Talk to a dementia expert with our free 24/7 Helpline. Get confidential support, crisis assistance,
local resources and information in over 200 languages.

**Call [800.272.3900][71]**
[Other ways to get help][72]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

Ingredients (APIs) suppliers while ensuring full regulatory compliance. Our platform offers a

global regulations. With a robust database of APIs and suppliers, alongside expert guidance, we help
businesses make informed decisions, maintain compliance, and streamline procurement.

processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from

## Simplifying healthcare with AI

With thousands of use cases, dedicated AI teams and powerful data, we solve your toughest challenges
and strengthen the healthcare ecosystem. Discover how our responsible AI-based solutions deliver
measurable results to improve efficiency, patient experiences and health outcomes.

[Explore AI solutions][63]

## Our healthcare solutions

We build solutions that deliver improved outcomes, create efficiency, drive value and offer better
experiences for the people you help every day. 

### Consulting services

Move from strategy to action with teams who know healthcare.

[View consulting services][64]

### **Data and analytics**

Turn real-world data into insights you can use.

[View data and analytics solutions][65]

### **Financial solutions**

Reduce friction across payment workflows.

[View financial solutions][66]

### **Health benefits solutions**

Design benefit plans that fit people’s lives.

[View health benefits solutions][67]

### **Healthcare access**

Help people get the right care at the right time.

[View healthcare access][68]

### **Operations and technology**

Modernize your team processes and workflows.

[View operations and technology][69]

### **Pharmacy benefit management**

Drive better health outcomes and lower costs.

[View pharmacy benefit management][70]

### **Pharmacies**

Improve medication adherence and access.

[View pharmacy solutions][71]

## Accredited for quality

Optum programs meet rigorous healthcare industry standards for safety, reliable outcomes and
continuous improvement.

[See all our accreditations][72]
* [ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy gold seal] Learn more
  
  ### ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy
  
  Optum Infusion Pharmacy is accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Health Care (ACHC) for
  pharmacy services backed by rigorous quality standards. This designation recognizes our commitment
  to safety, accuracy and improved health outcomes.
  
  [View infusion services][73]
* [NABP Accredited Digital Pharmacy seal] Learn more
  
  ### NABP – Digital Pharmacy
  
  Optum Pharmacy is proud to be a National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) Accredited
  Digital Pharmacy. This independent, third-party verification demonstrates how our operations meet
  the highest standards for patients who count on convenient, reliable and safe online pharmacy
  services. 
  
  [View pharmacy services][74]
* [URAC Accreditation for Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) seal] Learn more
  
  ### URAC – Pharmacy Benefit Management
  
  Optum Rx is accredited by URAC for Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), which reflects our
  dedication to formulary decision-making grounded in safety, efficacy and therapeutic need;
  transparent financial disclosures and continuous quality improvement.
  
  [View PBM solutions][75]
* [NCQA Accredited Utilization Management 3 years seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Utilization Management
  
  Optum Rx is accredited for Utilization Management by the National Committee for Quality Assurance
  (NCQA). This distinction reflects our commitment to fair, timely and evidence-based
  decision-making by utilization professionals, built on a framework of continuous quality
  improvement. 
  
  [View PBM solutions][76]
* [NCQA – Population Health Program seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Population Health Program
  
  The Optum Health Population Health Program accreditation from the National Committee for Quality
  Assurance (NCQA) validates that our approach to managing defined populations follows industry best
  practices — helping keep members healthier while reducing unnecessary costs.
  
  [View solutions][77]
* [NCQA – Wellness and Health Promotion seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Wellness and Health Promotion
  
  Optum Health earned the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Certification in Wellness
  and Health Promotion for Health Appraisal and Self-Management Tools — independent validation that
  our wellness programs use evidence-based methods proven to support health and improve outcomes.
  
  [View solutions][78]

## Accredited for quality

Optum programs meet rigorous healthcare industry standards for safety, reliable outcomes and
continuous improvement.

[See all our accreditations][72]
* [ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy gold seal] Learn more
  
  ### ACHC – Infusion Pharmacy
  
  Optum Infusion Pharmacy is accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Health Care (ACHC) for
  pharmacy services backed by rigorous quality standards. This designation recognizes our commitment
  to safety, accuracy and improved health outcomes.
  
  [View infusion services][73]
* [NABP Accredited Digital Pharmacy seal] Learn more
  
  ### NABP – Digital Pharmacy
  
  Optum Pharmacy is proud to be a National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) Accredited
  Digital Pharmacy. This independent, third-party verification demonstrates how our operations meet
  the highest standards for patients who count on convenient, reliable and safe online pharmacy
  services. 
  
  [View pharmacy services][74]
* [URAC Accreditation for Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) seal] Learn more
  
  ### URAC – Pharmacy Benefit Management
  
  Optum Rx is accredited by URAC for Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), which reflects our
  dedication to formulary decision-making grounded in safety, efficacy and therapeutic need;
  transparent financial disclosures and continuous quality improvement.
  
  [View PBM solutions][75]
* [NCQA Accredited Utilization Management 3 years seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Utilization Management
  
  Optum Rx is accredited for Utilization Management by the National Committee for Quality Assurance
  (NCQA). This distinction reflects our commitment to fair, timely and evidence-based
  decision-making by utilization professionals, built on a framework of continuous quality
  improvement. 
  
  [View PBM solutions][76]
* [NCQA – Population Health Program seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Population Health Program
  
  The Optum Health Population Health Program accreditation from the National Committee for Quality
  Assurance (NCQA) validates that our approach to managing defined populations follows industry best
  practices — helping keep members healthier while reducing unnecessary costs.
  
  [View solutions][77]
* [NCQA – Wellness and Health Promotion seal] Learn more
  
  ### NCQA – Wellness and Health Promotion
  
  Optum Health earned the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Certification in Wellness
  and Health Promotion for Health Appraisal and Self-Management Tools — independent validation that
  our wellness programs use evidence-based methods proven to support health and improve outcomes.
  
  [View solutions][78]

## Camber Specialty Products

###### hospitals, clinics, government facilities, and other institutional partners more high-quality

## Camber Consumer Care Over-the-Counter Products

###### We deliver high quality, over-the-counter medications you can trust. Our mission is to
###### provide a focused and reliable supply of products to the marketplace, creating value for our
###### partners and savings for the consumer.

[Learn more][52]
[2024_CCCLogoREV_26]

## Vertical Advantage

###### Many of the generic medications Camber Pharmaceuticals offers in the United States are
###### vertically integrated, from KSMs to APIs to FDFs. Camber products have consistent quality and
###### reliable supply channels, helping reduce supply interruptions and mitigate risk.

[Learn more][53]

## Business Development

###### At Camber Pharmaceuticals, our goal is to bring affordable medicines to as many people as
###### possible. As a company, we are continually interested in exploring business partnerships and
###### licensing agreements with strategically aligned companies to support our diverse pipeline of
###### generic products.

[Learn more][54]

## Camber Cares

###### Camber is committed to helping those in need through strategic product donations to a variety
###### of outstanding charitable organizations.

[Learn more][55]

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.

  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.

# Expert Pharmaceutical State Licensing Services

PRACTICE AREAS

Are you concerned about regulatory gaps in your current state licensing program? 

Does your company risk facing business interruptions because you need to show proof of state
licensure to manufacture, distribute, or sell a drug or device?  

Are you looking for cost-effective options for managing your current state licensing program?

Complete Compliance Solutions specializes in pharmaceutical state licensing services, ensuring your
business stays compliant and streamlined. Whether you deal with manufacturing or distributing
pharmaceuticals, our expert team is here to help you secure and manage the necessary licenses
efficiently.

 

By partnering with us, you can focus on growing your business while we handle the complexities of
regulatory compliance. Trust us to simplify your pharmaceutical licensing needs.

PRACTICE AREAS

## Our Pharma State Licensing Services

### OTC & Rx State Drug Manufacturing Licensing 

Drug manufacturing models include physical manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations
(CMOs), and virtual manufacturers. State pharmaceutical licensing requirements depend on the unique
manufacturing model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx) .

Complete Compliance Solutions partners with OTC and Rx drug manufacturers to identify and secure
state licenses appropriate for their unique manufacturing model and manage license renewals.

[Learn More ][16]

### OTC & Rx State Drug Distribution Licensing 

Distribution models vary based on whether the company distributes their own pharmaceutical products,
distributes products manufactured by other companies, or distributes products under the direction of
a distributor or manufacturer. State agencies regulate distributors differently depending on their
unique distribution model and drug product category (OTC vs Rx).

Complete Compliance Solutions assists OTC and Rx drug distributors with identifying the appropriate
license type, securing required licenses, and managing license renewals. 

[Learn More ][17]

### OTC & Rx State Medical Device Manufacturer and Distributor Licensing 

Medical device manufacturers and distributors are regulated by state agencies based on their unique
business model and medical device category (OTC vs Rx). Device manufacturing models include
own-product manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), and virtual manufacturers.

Complete Compliance Solutions manages state licensing for OTC and Rx medical device manufacturing
and distribution companies. 

[Learn More ][18]

## Each State Has Different Licensing Requirements
## 
## Partner with Complete Compliance Solutions to Ensure Your Business is Compliant

[687665.jpg]

Every state has the authority to regulate OTC and Rx drugs and medical devices in their state. 
Unlike a single pharmaceutical establishment registration required by the Food and Drug
Administration (FDA), several state licenses may be required to legally manufacture, distribute, and
sell pharmaceuticals in the United States. And, each state regulates the supply chain differently.


The challenge facing pharma companies is matching their unique business model to each state
regulation to determine necessary licenses. Once required licenses are identified, companies can be
overwhelmed by the complicated application process unique to every state. 

 

Compliance does not end when licenses are issued.  Each license requires renewal, with expiration
dates and renewal requirements differing by state.

 

And, state licensing regulations change. These changes can be difficult to locate and stakeholders
are often unaware of changes.


Click the link below for a directory to each state’s licensing agency.

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.

* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.

* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.

Entrepreneur India is a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS),
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

  ### Forward integration for DC

* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the

[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

List your brand, post distribution offers and get matched with vetted partners.

List my brand→][23][

For distributors & agents

### I'm a Distributor

Build your profile, discover brands that fit and request introductions.

Join as a distributor→][24]

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

August 30, 2021

[**Lannett Commences Marketing Mycophenolate Mofetil For Oral Suspension**][36]

powder for oral suspension. Currently, only two other competitors market generic Mycophenolate

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers

advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

# Migraine Help and Hope

Welcome to Migraine Again! Living with migraine and frequent headaches is tough – we get it because
we live it too. Our [editorial team][42] understands firsthand the daily challenges. That's why
we're dedicated to providing you with reliable information and practical tips to help you navigate
work, life, and everything in between, all while holding hope for a future without migraine.

Learn more [about migraine][43] from leading headache specialists and patient advocates, discover
some of our most [popular topics][44], take our [Migraine vs. Headache quiz][45], and learn more

Стационар и амбулаторный центр

Авторская психиатрическая клиника доктора наук Виталия Минутко основана в 2003 году  и стала
практически первой частной психотерапевтической и психиатрической клиникой России с круглосуточным
стационаром. Сегодня клиника известна как в России, так и за рубежом и специализируется на лечение
психических, неврологических и психосоматических расстройств.  
В арсенале клиники молекулярно-генетические, иммунологические, нейрофизиологические,
нейропсихологические и другие методы диагностики и лечения. 
Гарантия нашего профессионализма - это более 12 000 благодарных пациентов.

[Клиника доктора Минутко В.В.]
Минутко Виталий Леонидович

Основатель и руководитель клиники — доктор медицинских наук, психиатр, психотерапевт Виталий
Леонидович Минутко. 
В. Минутко - автор 7 книг и монографий: «Шизофрения», «Депрессия», «Навязчивые состояния»,
«Справочник психотерапевта» в двух изданиях, «Неправильное питание», «Алкоголизм», а также автор
более 50 научных статей.
Лауреат международной премии «Профессия — жизнь» (2006 г.), награды «Лучшему автору» ВДНХ (2000 г.)
лучший психиатр десятилетия (2020 г.) по версии сайта «Доктор на работе», а также патента на метод
моделирования спонтанной ремиссии алкоголизма.

[Минутко В. Л.]
Диагностика

На этапе диагностики врач выявляет все возможные причины и механизмы развития психоневрологического
расстройства, особенности личности пациента и его окружения.
Пациенты проходят индивидуально подобранную программу исследований: гормональные и иммунологические
анализы, нейрофизиологические и нейропсихологические исследования, а также самые современные методы
МРТ, включая трактографию (DTI), воксельметрию, функциональное МРТ.
На основании данных исследований индивидуально подбирается терапия, которая включает как
медикаментозные, так и немедикаментозные методы.

[Диагностика]
Лечение

Для каждого пациента разрабатывается индивидуальный курс лечения на основании данных диагностики.   
Мы стараемся избегать лечения психотропными препаратами, особенно у детей и лиц пожилого возраста, а
в тех случаях, когда оно необходимо, предпочитаем кратковременный курс одного современного препарата
с контролем его концентрации в крови. 
Важная роль в терапии отводится немедикаментозным методам лечения: ТМС, tDCS, БОС, лазерной терапии,
плазмаферезу, а также психотерапии в разных формах (индивидуальная групповая, семейная).

[Лечение]
Российская Нейропсихиатрическая Ассоциация

Российская нейропсихиатрическая ассоциация, возглавляемая В.Л. Минутко, объединяет неврологов и
психиатров, психологов и биологов, словом, всех специалистов, работающих в области ментального
здоровья. 
В противовес центробежным тенденциям современной медицины с её узкой специализацией, ассоциация,
напротив, стимулирует объединение специалистов всех профессий, работающих с заболеваниями мозга. На
учредительной конференции ассоциации (2019 г.), присутствовало более 200 докладчиков из разных стран
мира. Ежегодно ассоциация проводит научно-практические конференции и круглые столы, посвященные
актуальным проблемам нейропсихиатрии.

# [Диагностика][65]

### [Трактография (DTI) и воксельметрия][66]

[[Магнитно-резонасная томография с трактографией (DTI) и воксельметрией]][67]

Современному врачу психиатру необходимы результаты объективных исследований мозга. В наиболее
простом варианте это исследование функциональной активности мозга с помощью электроэнцефалограммы и
изображение мозга с помощью магнитно-резонасной томографии. Однако, достижения последних 20 лет…
[-][68]

### [Функциональное МРТ][69]

[[Функциональное МРТ]][70]

фМРТ позволяет определить активность различных структур мозга при выполнении определенных задач и в
состоянии покоя. Метод основан на детекции различий в кровотоке структур мозга.

### [Генетические исследования][71]

[[Генетические исследования]][72]

Работаем с новейшими методиками: секвенированием полного генома (все гены человека) и полного экзома
(1% наиболее важных последовательностей). Рекомендуется в детской психиатрии и при резистентных
заболеваниях.

С какой целью пациенту с психическими расстройствами назначаются генетические… [-][73]

[[Электроэнцефалограмма (ЭЭГ)]][75]

Электроэнцефалография мозга (ЭЭГ) - Исследование позволяет выявить нарушения биоэлектрических ритмов
мозга. Рекомендуется при большинстве ментальных расстройств: при депрессии, тревожных расстройствах,
аутизме, СДВГ, психозах, шизофрении и др. ЭЭГ абсолютно безопасно, его можно проводить с… [-][76]

### [Вызванные потенциалы][77]

[[Вызванные потенциалы]][78]

Вызванные потенциалы подразделяются на несколько групп исследований: слуховые, зрительные,
когнитивные. ВП применяются для оценки скорости обработки информации в мозге, локализации нарушений,
а также для определения ошибок мышления и восприятия. Вызванные потенциалы применяются при
большинстве… [-][79]

### [Фармакоэлектроэнцефалография][80]

Метод позволяет оценить выраженность побочных эффектов психотропных препаратов на ЭЭГ, а также
прогнозировать эффективность назначения препаратов и физиотерапии.

### [Фармакогенетика][82]

[[Фармакогенетика]][83]

Исследование позволяет по данным генетического исследования определить наиболее эффективные
препараты для терапии различных заболеваний, рекомендуемые дозировки и возможные риски побочных
эффектов.

### [Определение нейроинфекций][84]

[[Определение нейроинфекций]][85]

Анализы на весь спектр нейроинфекций: вирусы (вирус Эпштейна-Барр, цитомегаловирус, герпес 1, 2, 6
типов и др), бактерии (менингококки, стрептококки), грибковые инфекции, простейшие (токсоплазма) и
др.
Мы живем в мире, населенным разнообразными живыми организмами, каждый из которых ежедневно… [-][86]

## [Методы лечения][88]

### [Стационарное лечение в клинике Минутко][89]

[[Стационарное лечение в клинике Минутко]][90]

Лечение в частном психиатрическом стационаре – оптимальный выбор для резистентных или острых случаев
любых ментальных заболеваний, от аутизма до ОКР и тяжелой депрессии.
Нередко полноценное лечение психических расстройств бывает невозможным вне условий стационара.
Острые психические заболевания… [-][91]

### [Транскраниальная магнитная стимуляция][92]

[[Транскраниальная магнитная стимуляция]][93]

ТМС – метод, основанный на воздействии магнитного поля на определенные участки мозга. Используется
при терапии депрессии, ОКР, тревожных расстройств, галлюцинаций и других заболеваний.
Транскраниальная магнитная стимуляция (ТМС) — метод, основанный на том, что изменяющееся во …
[-][94]

### [Лечение в терапевтическом окне][95]

[[терапевтическое окно]][96]

"Терапевтический индекс" ("терапевтическое окно") часто определяется как отношение минимальной
токсичности концентрации препарата к его минимальной терапевтической концентрации ( Levy C., 1998).

### [Монотерапия][98]

[[Монотерапия]][99]

Монотерапия – это подбор одного, наиболее подходящего для пациента препарата, который заменяет
несколько ранее назначенных лекарств. Монотерапия позволяет снизить количество побочных эффектов.
Фармакология широко применяется в лечении психических расстройств, пограничных состояний и …
[-][100]

### [Подбор препарата по фармакогенетике][101]

[[Подбор препарата по фармакогенетике]][102]

Для персонализированного и наиболее точного подбора препарата, с максимальной эффективностью и
минимальным риском побочных эффектов, используются данные генетических исследований.

### [Биологическая обратная связь][103]

[[Биологическая обратная связь (БОС)]][104]

БОС – это безопасный и эффективный метод терапии, который обучает пациента контролировать
физиологические реакции организма (ЭЭГ, дыхание, насыщение кислородом итд). Применяется при СДВГ,
тревожных и других расстройствах.

на берегу озера.

Стационар и амбулаторный центр

Авторская психиатрическая клиника доктора наук Виталия Минутко основана в 2003 году  и стала
практически первой частной психотерапевтической и психиатрической клиникой России с круглосуточным
стационаром. Сегодня клиника известна как в России, так и за рубежом и специализируется на лечение
психических, неврологических и психосоматических расстройств.  
В арсенале клиники молекулярно-генетические, иммунологические, нейрофизиологические,
нейропсихологические и другие методы диагностики и лечения. 
Гарантия нашего профессионализма - это более 12 000 благодарных пациентов.

[Клиника доктора Минутко В.В.]
Минутко Виталий Леонидович

Основатель и руководитель клиники — доктор медицинских наук, психиатр, психотерапевт Виталий
Леонидович Минутко. 
В. Минутко - автор 7 книг и монографий: «Шизофрения», «Депрессия», «Навязчивые состояния»,
«Справочник психотерапевта» в двух изданиях, «Неправильное питание», «Алкоголизм», а также автор
более 50 научных статей.
Лауреат международной премии «Профессия — жизнь» (2006 г.), награды «Лучшему автору» ВДНХ (2000 г.)
лучший психиатр десятилетия (2020 г.) по версии сайта «Доктор на работе», а также патента на метод
моделирования спонтанной ремиссии алкоголизма.

[Минутко В. Л.]
Диагностика

На этапе диагностики врач выявляет все возможные причины и механизмы развития психоневрологического
расстройства, особенности личности пациента и его окружения.
Пациенты проходят индивидуально подобранную программу исследований: гормональные и иммунологические
анализы, нейрофизиологические и нейропсихологические исследования, а также самые современные методы
МРТ, включая трактографию (DTI), воксельметрию, функциональное МРТ.
На основании данных исследований индивидуально подбирается терапия, которая включает как
медикаментозные, так и немедикаментозные методы.

[Диагностика]
Лечение

Для каждого пациента разрабатывается индивидуальный курс лечения на основании данных диагностики.   
Мы стараемся избегать лечения психотропными препаратами, особенно у детей и лиц пожилого возраста, а
в тех случаях, когда оно необходимо, предпочитаем кратковременный курс одного современного препарата
с контролем его концентрации в крови. 
Важная роль в терапии отводится немедикаментозным методам лечения: ТМС, tDCS, БОС, лазерной терапии,
плазмаферезу, а также психотерапии в разных формах (индивидуальная групповая, семейная).

[Лечение]
Российская Нейропсихиатрическая Ассоциация

Российская нейропсихиатрическая ассоциация, возглавляемая В.Л. Минутко, объединяет неврологов и
психиатров, психологов и биологов, словом, всех специалистов, работающих в области ментального
здоровья. 
В противовес центробежным тенденциям современной медицины с её узкой специализацией, ассоциация,
напротив, стимулирует объединение специалистов всех профессий, работающих с заболеваниями мозга. На
учредительной конференции ассоциации (2019 г.), присутствовало более 200 докладчиков из разных стран
мира. Ежегодно ассоциация проводит научно-практические конференции и круглые столы, посвященные
актуальным проблемам нейропсихиатрии.

# [Диагностика][65]

### [Трактография (DTI) и воксельметрия][66]

[[Магнитно-резонасная томография с трактографией (DTI) и воксельметрией]][67]

Современному врачу психиатру необходимы результаты объективных исследований мозга. В наиболее
простом варианте это исследование функциональной активности мозга с помощью электроэнцефалограммы и
изображение мозга с помощью магнитно-резонасной томографии. Однако, достижения последних 20 лет…
[-][68]

### [Функциональное МРТ][69]

[[Функциональное МРТ]][70]

фМРТ позволяет определить активность различных структур мозга при выполнении определенных задач и в
состоянии покоя. Метод основан на детекции различий в кровотоке структур мозга.

### [Генетические исследования][71]

[[Генетические исследования]][72]

Работаем с новейшими методиками: секвенированием полного генома (все гены человека) и полного экзома
(1% наиболее важных последовательностей). Рекомендуется в детской психиатрии и при резистентных
заболеваниях.

(1% наиболее важных последовательностей). Рекомендуется в детской психиатрии и при резистентных
заболеваниях.

### [ЭЭГ и суточное ЭЭГ][74]

[[Электроэнцефалограмма (ЭЭГ)]][75]

Электроэнцефалография мозга (ЭЭГ) - Исследование позволяет выявить нарушения биоэлектрических ритмов
мозга. Рекомендуется при большинстве ментальных расстройств: при депрессии, тревожных расстройствах,
аутизме, СДВГ, психозах, шизофрении и др. ЭЭГ абсолютно безопасно, его можно проводить с… [-][76]

### [Вызванные потенциалы][77]

[[Вызванные потенциалы]][78]

Вызванные потенциалы подразделяются на несколько групп исследований: слуховые, зрительные,
когнитивные. ВП применяются для оценки скорости обработки информации в мозге, локализации нарушений,
а также для определения ошибок мышления и восприятия. Вызванные потенциалы применяются при
большинстве… [-][79]

### [Фармакоэлектроэнцефалография][80]

[[Фармакоэлектроэнцефалография]][81]

Метод позволяет оценить выраженность побочных эффектов психотропных препаратов на ЭЭГ, а также
прогнозировать эффективность назначения препаратов и физиотерапии.

### [Фармакогенетика][82]

[[Фармакогенетика]][83]

Исследование позволяет по данным генетического исследования определить наиболее эффективные
препараты для терапии различных заболеваний, рекомендуемые дозировки и возможные риски побочных
эффектов.

### [Определение нейроинфекций][84]

[[Определение нейроинфекций]][85]

Анализы на весь спектр нейроинфекций: вирусы (вирус Эпштейна-Барр, цитомегаловирус, герпес 1, 2, 6
типов и др), бактерии (менингококки, стрептококки), грибковые инфекции, простейшие (токсоплазма) и
др.

любых ментальных заболеваний, от аутизма до ОКР и тяжелой депрессии.
Нередко полноценное лечение психических расстройств бывает невозможным вне условий стационара.

[-][94]

токсичности концентрации препарата к его минимальной терапевтической концентрации ( Levy C., 1998).

### [Монотерапия][98]

Монотерапия – это подбор одного, наиболее подходящего для пациента препарата, который заменяет
несколько ранее назначенных лекарств. Монотерапия позволяет снизить количество побочных эффектов.

[[Подбор препарата по фармакогенетике]][102]

Для персонализированного и наиболее точного подбора препарата, с максимальной эффективностью и
минимальным риском побочных эффектов, используются данные генетических исследований.

тревожных и других расстройствах.

Стационар нашей клиники предназначен для лечения сложных и резистентных к лечению пациентов любого
возраста. Здесь вы получите возможность пребывания вместе с родственниками, анонимность, комфорт
(только одно- и двухместные палаты), ограниченный круг пациентов (3−4 в стационаре), индивидуальное
питание, оптимальный распорядок дня, предусматривающий большой объем исследований и терапевтических
процедур. В вашем распоряжении библиотека стационара, тренажерный зал, комната арт-терапии. 
Доброжелательный и высококвалифицированный персонал, современное и диагностическое и терапевтическое
оборудование обеспечат быстрое обследование (2-3 дня), комплексное и качественное лечение (10-14
дней). Наша загородная клиника отличается чистой экологией. Есть своя прогулочная территория в лесу
на берегу озера.

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.
